notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strong activations are the token just before or inside the next digits of a multi-digit number (space, comma separator, or 1st digit) in lists of statistics, sums and percentages; the packet shows no broader meaning. The - pole is separate (letter closings), and here only the + pole is labelled.
